native_validation.disposition: Routine runs seven processor/process cases, two actual PostgreSQL lock races, and the prohibited-metadata privacy boundary. Full qualification retains all 20 native process cases against the unchanged frozen corpus. The thirteen repository validation decisions have one fast typed-snapshot owner; five distinct released-schema PostgreSQL cases retain scope, disable, generation and reference-existence adapter proofs. The ten full-only cases also retain the actual worker-port owner. Neither lower layer proves process, HTTPS, OAuth, or lock-race behavior. Hosted routine and full qualification remain required.

historical_disposition.tier: weekly/manual full qualification and exact-main official-release prerequisite; omitted from routine PR/merge-group Canvas target
historical_disposition.oracle_role: Independent digest-pinned published Python image and PostgreSQL behavior compared with frozen corpus; native case names are not substitutes for this reference regeneration.
historical_disposition.cheapest_proving_layer: Retain real published-process replay for the corpus-equality assertion; pure decision assertions can have separate fast owners but cannot replace this independent oracle.
historical_disposition.case_inputs: Each test also consumes its same-stem canvas-worker-*-oracle.json corpus, corresponding -scenarios.json, producer runner and transitive imports recorded by the existing producer/script/scenario inventories. Those inventories are bounded, not complete environment provenance.

preflight_disposition.tier: timeout and lease-expiry run as routine preflights, while mixed-roster and body-timeout native matrices are tier-excluded from routine CI; all four run in weekly/manual full qualification; the later full-qualification target invocation skips four same-run preflights after executable/run/mode proof
preflight_disposition.oracle_role: Native regression sentinels against frozen published cases, not a replacement for live historical regeneration.
preflight_disposition.cheapest_proving_layer: Retain owned process, PostgreSQL and HTTPS boundaries for these cases; lower-level pure matrices may be additional checks, not substitutes.
